client.app/cache/npc/calcs.ts: TAKEN (8302734d). GDA buy price: the deficit exponent is clamped to MAX_DEFICIT_PERIODS = 3 and the price is at least 1 currency per unit (Math.max(amt, ceil(price))). Hand-checked against LibListing.calcBuyPrice at the new pin: same clamp (gdaCapSeconds = prevSold*period/rate + 3*period), same floor (price < amt ? amt : price). Served by `merchant` listing buyPrice.

contracts/libraries.LibListing.sol: GDA clamp + 1-per-unit floor (mirrored by the client calc above) and settleGDA on buy (state-side; the mirror sees the settled TimeStart). MAX_BATCH_PERIODS = 100 is a revert bound on batch size; the lens quotes amount 1. No other served formula.
contracts/libraries.LibPool.sol (new): Constant-product swap: calcAmountOut = floor(amountIn*(10000-fee)*reserveOut / (reserveIn*10000 + amountIn*(10000-fee))); swap reverts on amountOut == 0. Mirrored by the client's network/shapes/Pool/pricing.ts (ported verbatim, BigInt). Served by the new `quote` query; verified chain-exact by gate G2.e.
contracts/libraries.LibPoolRegistry.sol (new): Pool id = keccak256(abi.encodePacked('amm.pool', lo, hi)); fee in Rate; items in Keys. Matches the client's genPoolEntity.
contracts/libraries.LibTokenPortal.sol: Claim pays an explicit `to` (owner, or the account's CURRENT operator for an operator-lane receipt, resolved at claim time); receipt is cleared before the transfer. Token/item unit conversion unchanged. Served by the new `receipts` query.
contracts/libraries.LibTrade.sol: Trade tax is now burned from escrow (ca9b77aa). The lens serves no trade-tax arithmetic; no served value changes.
contracts/libraries.LibInventory.sol: Adds transferForNoLog (pool moves skip acquisition logging). No served formula.
contracts/libraries.LibItem.sol: Adds verifyForShapeOr (Flash Talisman ANY_KAMI). No served formula.
contracts/libraries.LibGacha.sol: Pending-commit accounting (GACHA_COMMITS_PENDING) and getNumFree. The lens serves no gacha pool count; no served value changes.
contracts/libraries.LibKamiCreate.sol: Mint clamps to remaining 721 supply. No served formula.
contracts/libraries.LibKamiMarket.sol / LibKamiMarketIndex.s: Active-listing index (Values on a fixed entity) for the vendor floor price. The lens serves no kami-market price derived from it.
contracts/libraries.utils/LibArray.sol: Adds sortAndVerifyNoRepeats (duplicate-id rejection, f17cac43). No served formula.
